TST-027: 7 checks of rewritten log text. The 3 pin-duration checks pass since CMB-120 (1-round pin, renewal on the pinner's next turn). The pass count also takes in assertions added by CMB-085, CMB-102 and CMB-106, whose commits did not refresh it, and the 22 trip checks of CMB-079 (432 on 2026-10-08); 467 after the CMB-102 natural-weapon rulings of 2026-10-08 (six tests replaced the natural sunder refusal; they also cover the PHB p.155/p.158 size and handedness terms of disarm and sunder); 476 after CMB-126; 493 after CMB-127 (six grapple natural-attack tests replaced the old Haste grapple-routine test, two of them for grapple checks staying on the BAB ladder and refused natural attacks); 500 after CMB-125 (the Trip (Ex) trigger attack: helper, NPC data, AI rider count and the shared free-trip path).

The 3 tolerated failures are either the three "Main-hand weapon destroyed - ..." checks (6 of 67 seeds) or the three "Shield destroyed - ..." checks (1 of 67); none fail with the baseline seed.
